issue_27.title: [FORMAL E2E][Authority] New task cannot initialize GUI ledger: fixed path collides with immutable prior-task ledger
source_facts: src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:419-423 hard-codes the expected grant gui_ledger path to PROJECT_DIR + '/private/gui-ledger.json' and refuses any grant that points elsewhere
src/line_backup_batch/cli.py:501-505 repeats the same hard-coded gui_ledger binding on the one56 route
src/line_backup_batch/store.py:368-373 Store.ledger_path() accepts any grant ledger path starting with harness-development/ and ending with gui-ledger.json, checking only prefix, suffix and traversal

src/line_backup_batch/store.py:492-505 initialize_project_ledger() requires the target ledger path and its gui-ledger-initialization.json receipt to be completely unused, otherwise PROJECT_LEDGER_ALREADY_EXISTS (store.py:500) or PROJECT_LEDGER_ALREADY_INITIALIZED
src/line_backup_batch/store.py:429-454 _ledger_open() requires the receipt and the ledger to agree on task_id, owner, profile, cap and ledger_path
issue_27.consequence: Keeping the existing ledger path is refused by the ledger-initialization layer and moving to a new task id with a new ledger path is refused by the Authorizer hard-coded grant binding, so a new formal task cannot initialize any ledger under the current authority design. The two conditions close each other; this is a second, independent, design-level blocker.
issue_27.note: Discovered by source reading at the reviewed product head, NOT live-triggered in this round.
